entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-07 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 enabled sources were attempted at 08:07–08:11 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready (available through Nov 6); the complete Nov 5 and Nov 6 boards contained 39 and 31 papers. Reconciliation added 46 identities and four recommendation dates; three-round review supported two inclusions and 48 scope exclusions, retaining their original HF dates. Three arXiv queries succeeded with zero results; 13 GitHub repositories had zero releases in the source window. All five RSS feeds succeeded, returning 58 window entries. S2 citations yielded seven window entries from the first 100 raw records before 429 throttling; citation continuation and author tracking were not fully collected. This is a collection and review brief, not a claim of new papers or no updates for the whole day.

entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-08 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 08:04–08:13 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready; the latest available complete board, Nov 6, contained 32 papers, with late member Coca-Cola excluded. Nineteen new identities yielded five individually reviewed papers for supplements dated Nov 4 or Nov 5, 13 exclusions, and Evolver pending evidence. Another 443 historical records were reviewed: 15 historical backlog inclusions, 419 exclusions and nine scope boundaries. Including source retries, the combined 467-row review has 434 exclusions, 15 historical backlog decisions and 18 deferrals. Five RSS feeds returned 59 window records; 13 GitHub repositories had no window releases. Three arXiv queries timed out or returned 429; anonymous S2 throttling left parts of the source uncollected. Older papers were not relabeled as new today. This is a collection snapshot, not a claim that no later updates exist.

entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-10 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 08:06–08:15 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready. Its API reported availability through Nov 8, but an explicit Nov 9 request succeeded with 31 papers, including 23 late additions; the full board was reconciled rather than relying on the stale availability hint. Forty-two new stable identities (38 source discoveries and four existing issue-only records) received source, scope and independent cross-review: eight support narrowly defined Harness scope, 33 are excluded, and one needs more evidence. CPU-ARC belongs in the Nov 9 supplement under its observed HF recommendation date; the other qualifying records have older source dates and remain labeled historical backlog. Eight older cases were also processed: six passed scope and qualitative-summary review, Evolver was excluded from Harness, and Cache Engineering still lacks specific evolution-version artifacts. The resulting 13 historical backlog decisions are recorded for this week, not counted as new papers today. Three arXiv searches succeeded with no window results; five RSS feeds returned 50 window records, and 13 GitHub repositories had no window releases. S2 citations returned 311 window records (278 unique identities); anonymous throttling and the 180-second source traversal window left parts of citation and author coverage uncollected. Uncollected coverage remains unknown. Sixteen free retries of eight older source blockers did not recover the required bodies. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection and review snapshot bulletin, not a new-paper edition or a claim that no later updates exist.

entry.title: Follow RSI · 2026-11-11 · Collection and review bulletin
entry.summary: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 08:07–08:12 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was not ready. The complete Nov 10 board contained 37 papers; the refreshed Nov 9 board contained 34, including three late additions. Across sources, 64 new stable identities (57 papers and seven official articles) received source and scope cross-review: seven support narrowly defined Harness scope, 54 are excluded, and three need more evidence. SciMARS, JoMoHa, MIRIX, RoboScript, BadEvolve, TRUST and SkillCache retain their actual older source dates as historical backlog, not new papers today. RoboScript qualifies only for its execution-validated tool-skill construction branch. REINS updates domain-rule memory, ReSkill produces an independent robot program, and SMO explicitly lacks execution feedback into its basis; these are not counted as Harness evolution. Sage-Taiyi and Auriga still need concrete evidence of automatic artifact revision and adoption across rounds; the Materials world models publisher body remains inaccessible. Three arXiv searches succeeded with no window records, five RSS feeds returned 52 window records, and 13 GitHub repositories had no window releases. S2 citations returned 314 window records covering 283 unique identities, but anonymous throttling and the traversal time window left parts uncollected; the author source also hit HTTP 429. Uncollected coverage remains unknown. Retries of eight older fulltext blockers did not recover the required bodies. A multiplier-versus-percentage conflict between SMO’s official abstract and body is recorded without altering either source. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection-time review-status bulletin, not a new-paper edition or a claim that no later updates exist.
